name: b2-mcp-mutation-tooling
description: Isolated, checked-in manifest for advisory StrykerJS mutation testing (issue #397). Kept outside the root workspace so the Babel instrumenter tree is pinned and reviewed with integrity hashes (its own committed pnpm-lock.yaml, installed --frozen-lockfile) but never enters the shipped root lockfile or dependency budget. vitest is pinned to the exact root version so mutation testing runs against the same test-runner major as the suite it assesses; the typescript peer resolves from the root node_modules (an ancestor of this directory).
